download_method: Python urllib.request.urlopen(versioned HTTPS PDF URL, timeout=40); pdftotext -layout (ViT/CLIP), pdftotext -raw (LLaVA). LLaVA PDF metadata/figure latexit text was excluded when displaying only method paragraphs.
conversion_note: ViT pdftotext reported xref reconstruction, returned exit 0; complete relevant §3.1 and Eq.(1) text was readable. No figure conclusion depends on this conversion.

papers.title: An Image Is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.quote: Position embeddings are added to the patch embeddings to retain positional information.
papers.inspection: 實讀§3.1：影像攤為patch序列、線性投影、加位置向量；Eq.(1)列明串接與Epos。§3.2把架構和資料訓練分開。不把本課逐位置MLP入口等同完整ViT，也不沿用任何論文效能數字。

papers.title: Visual Instruction Tuning
papers.quote: We consider a simple linear layer to connect image features into the word embedding space.
papers.inspection: 實讀§4.1投影Hv=W·Zv及相同文字embedding維度；§4.2把視覺和文字輸入整成序列，以逐token條件機率訓練答案，另列兩階段參數更新；§5.1才另述能力評估。它支持接線、學習及評估為不同命題，不能證明本課隨機小模型有成熟LLaVA能力。

papers.title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
papers.locator: §2.3 p.4, caption-prediction baseline versus whole-text pair selection; Figure 3 core objective p.5
papers.quote: predicting only which text as a whole is paired with which image and not the exact words of that text
papers.inspection: 實讀§2.3：先說逐字預測caption的基線，再明確區分整段圖文配對與確切字詞預測；N×N批內候選經餘弦分數與雙向交叉熵訓練。只支持配對選擇的任務定義，不把CLIP的資料量、效率或成績借給本課。
